title: Play: the running bit
turns: I have decided that the pigeons outside my window are running a surveillance operation and I need you to take this seriously.
Evidence item one: the same pigeon has been on the ledge three days in a row. Same pigeon. I'd know that pigeon anywhere.
Item two: yesterday it looked directly at me while I was eating a bagel. It knows about the bagel.
Okay agent, what's our counter-intelligence plan? I have a bag of birdseed and a laser pointer.
Wait. What if the birdseed is what they wanted all along.
I'm going to name it. Give me a name for my handler. Make it dignified.
